messages:
Sam: Late-night ask: I'm assembling a "soundtrack" for a 3-hour movie marathon + reading breaks. low-key, not bombastic. recs?
Ivy: Movie marathon rec: 'Wings of Desire' then 'Paris, Texas' for that quiet melancholy flow.
Noah: Soundtrack idea: acoustic instrumentals -> short ambient interludes -> piano pieces. keeps the mind calm.
Priya: For piano, try Agnes Obel or Dustin O'Halloran. both unobtrusive.
Sam: PlaylistBot, can you make a short mix?
PlaylistBot: Generated mix "Marathon Quiet" (1h30): https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake-marathon-quiet
Ivy: book recs for inter-episode reading: 'The Mezzanine' (for short, funny observations) or 'Stoner' if you're in the mood for slow prose.
Noah: Also 'The Melancholy of Anatomy' (short stories) for weird little bites between films.
Sam: Poll time: which opener should I use? react :one: :two: or :three:
PollBot: Poll created by Sam: "Marathon opener" \u2014 1) Slow solo piano; 2) Lo-fi acoustic guitar; 3) 60s film score ambient pad. Ends in 6h.
Ivy: voted :one: and :three:.
Noah: voted :two:.
Priya: voted :one:.
Sam: voted :one:. thanks everyone, will post the full schedule + timestamps after I test-run tonight :)
